metrics.detail: 0 of 240 presented frames contain world motion by ANY agent, camera-independent. The denominator gate.wake_fraction must be read against: a gate cannot beat the scene's own motion density, and v3 was authored to contain moving agents. This measures the gate's mechanism, not the Tier-1 economic claim -- that requires wake fraction over 24 hours of real office footage including nights and weekends, which does not yet exist.
